phase-summary.outcome: Completed the first real Payload authoring publish loop. The docs-site now has custom-schema and authoring-platform extension collections, a publish route that writes canonical project docs back into engine JSON/source files, a bootstrap command that seeds/imports the canonical pack set into Payload, applied DB migrations, and a successful publish pass that rebuilt engine and KAPLAY artifacts from DB-backed project data.

file.description: Added project custom schema records for non-canonical game schema extensions.
Added docs-site/Payload authoring extension records with fixed platform layer and namespaced authoring metadata.
Extended the authoring service with custom schema/platform CRUD, publish-to-engine behavior, and repo command execution for engine/KAPLAY rebuilds.
Added the publish endpoint that drives the end-to-end authoring publish loop.
Added a reusable automation command for project bootstrap, canonical import, and optional publish.
Generated and applied the migration for custom schema and platform data collections.
Added a minimal publish control and latest-publish visibility to the content-app workspace.
Fixed the engine package root export surface to include `PRESENTER_STRINGS`, keeping the pack registry and public package API aligned.
Recorded the working DB import/export/publish loop and the current seeded project state.

decision.summary: The canonical engine pack set is now imported into Payload as a real content project rather than being represented only on disk.
decision.impact: Creates an actual DB-backed authoring baseline for the content editor and future CRUD/validation flows.

decision.summary: Publishing writes project documents back into engine contract files and rebuilds artifacts instead of introducing direct runtime DB reads.
decision.impact: Preserves deterministic file-based runtime behavior while enabling DB-backed authoring and project management.

tests.test: pnpm --dir docs-site exec payload migrate:status --config payload.config.ts

data-state.item: Payload project `canonical-game-content` exists with project id `1`.
Canonical imports populated 34 schema-import rows and 34 pack-document rows.
Publish wrote canonical project files under `docs-site/content-projects/canonical-game-content/`.
Publish synced engine contract files and rebuilt engine + KAPLAY artifacts successfully.

next.action: Build per-pack CRUD editing and validation UI so authors can change pack JSON in the browser instead of relying only on import/publish commands.
Add revision history, validation runs, and publish-job records so the authoring loop has durable change tracking and machine-readable publish receipts.
